name: pregnancy specific beta-1-glycoprotein 4

function.text: PSG4 is the approved symbol for pregnancy specific beta-1-glycoprotein 4. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in female pregnancy.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
